title: Tolerance-driven close evaluation of the Stokes double layer potential on axisymmetric surfaces
summary: We consider boundary integral methods for Stokes mobility and resistance problems involving smooth axisymmetric particles. A primary numerical challenge is the accurate and efficient evaluation of layer potentials at off-surface points close to particle surfaces. We present a tolerance-driven workflow for evaluating the Stokes double layer potential at such evaluation points (targets) to prescribed accuracy while avoiding unnecessary computational cost.
